name: create_action_item
description: Create a new action item (task) for the current user with a P0–P4 priority. Returns the new item's id and a confirmation message. The acting user is resolved from session state — do NOT pass user_id.

title.description: Short imperative summary of the task, e.g. 'Send invoice to Acme'.

priority.description: P0 critical/blocker, P1 24h urgent, P2 standard, P3 backlog, P4 log/reference.

content_details.description: Optional longer description, links, or context.

target_date.description: Optional ISO-8601 datetime. If omitted, the item has no deadline.
